name: /help explains the bot in plain language

payload.text:
GroupGuard keeps your group protected.

/start — Start the bot
/help — Show all commands
/warn — Warn a member
/warnings — Check a member's warnings
/resetwarn — Remove a member's warnings
/mute — Mute a member
/unmute — Unmute a member
/kick — Remove a member from the group
/ban — Ban a member
/unban — Unban a member
/rules — Show group rules

For member actions, reply to that member's message before sending the command.
